research.name: read_research_context
research.description: Returns compact evidence pages; use the returned contextRef plus evidenceOffset=nextOffset to read more of the SAME frozen snapshot. Load a frozen personal stock research context by contextRef, or save a new snapshot with evidence, portfolio relationships, prior forecasts and relevant lessons. Pass the returned contextRef to the prediction specialist. New snapshots exclude subsequently observed evidence.

research.name: collect_evidence
research.description: Collect and persist company disclosures, news, web/IR pages and public comments, X discussion and macro vintages. Returns evidenceRefs, source status and explicit missing coverage. Reuse the same operation for retries, then freeze context with read_research_context.

research.name: read_forecasts
research.description: Read saved forward forecasts and deterministic outcomes for a symbol or one forecastId. Revisions do not erase original predictions. Excludes shadow experiment arms.

research.name: record_review
research.description: Record a settled forecast review, distinguishing observed outcome from causal attribution. Optionally propose a scoped candidate lesson for subsequent isolated shadow trials. One review cannot automatically promote a lesson.

research.name: market_history
research.description: Fetch and persist verified daily OHLCV. Returns an operation with datasetRef, or explicit failure.

research.name: quant_calculate
research.description: Compute from authorized references only. Research: indicators; prediction: prediction; portfolio: portfolio.

research.name: read_dataset
research.description: Read a saved dataset and provenance.

research.name: read_result
research.description: Read an immutable calculation or research result.

research.name: read_holdings
research.description: Read the exact manual holdings version selected by the user. No holdings writes.

research.name: get_operation
research.description: Query a pending Market/Quant operation without resubmitting it.

research.name: submit_specialist
research.description: Dispatch at most one prediction and one portfolio specialist. Pass minimal question and authorized references; poll the returned childTaskId.

datasetRefs.description: Prediction: split-adjusted history. Portfolio: raw prices covering the holdings date, or an empty array so the specialist fetches them. Never pass split-adjusted research history as portfolio quotes.

research.name: get_specialist_result
research.description: Read a direct specialist task and its saved result references.

research.name: save_research_summary
research.description: Save plain-text research interpretation with its evidence references. Use the returned resultRef for a research_summary Canvas component; specialist calculation references are evidence inputs, not research_summary resultRefs.

research.name: canvas_upsert
research.description: Create or replace a component using saved references. stock_chart requires datasetRef. Other components require matching resultRef: indicator_panel=indicators, prediction_result=legacy prediction, forecast_result=forecast, forecast_evaluation=forecast_evaluation, review=review, portfolio_summary=portfolio, research_summary=save_research_summary result. Never use a specialist resultRef for research_summary. Omit artifactId when creating; reuse it only to replace a component.

research.name: canvas_patch
research.description: Replace title or display properties; never change factual data using patch.

research.name: canvas_remove
research.description: Remove a component from this research revision.

prediction.name: publish_forecast
prediction.description: Publish one immutable 5- or 20-session model forecast from a frozen researchContextRef. All distribution values are decimal strings. The server fixes future first-open/target-close dates. Use supersedesForecastId for a revised judgment; old forecasts remain evaluable. Returns forecastId/resultRef for forecast_result Canvas.

prediction.name: get_trial_context
prediction.description: Read only the frozen evidence and method assigned to this isolated shadow experiment arm. Available only for an assigned trial task; never returns the other arm's output.

prediction.name: publish_forecast_trial_arm
prediction.description: Persist this task's assigned control or candidate distribution before the planned opening time. It does not create a primary user forecast. Use only get_trial_context evidence.
